includeActiveStory.description: When enabled, includes the list of currently active public story snaps (ephemeral, changes frequently).
includeActiveStory.title: Include Active Story Snaps

includeComments.description: When enabled, decodes and includes Spotlight comments embedded in the profile page. Can produce large records.
includeComments.title: Include Spotlight Comments

includeLenses.description: When enabled, includes AR lenses created by the profile owner in the output.
includeLenses.title: Include AR Lenses

includeSpotlightMeta.description: When enabled, includes rich metadata for each Spotlight highlight (view counts, engagement stats, creator info, hashtags, etc.).
includeSpotlightMeta.title: Include Spotlight Metadata

maxHighlightsPerUser.description: Maximum number of highlights (curated and spotlight) to include per profile. Set to 0 to exclude all highlights. Leave blank for no limit.
maxHighlightsPerUser.title: Max Highlights Per User

maxRelatedAccounts.description: Maximum number of related accounts to include per profile. Set to 0 to exclude related accounts entirely. Leave blank for no limit.
maxRelatedAccounts.title: Max Related Accounts

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Public Snapchat profiles work without proxy; include for resilience at scale.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

usernames.description: One or more Snapchat usernames or profile URLs. Accepted formats: bare username (brentrivera), @-prefixed (@brentrivera), add URL (https://www.snapchat.com/add/brentrivera), or profile URL (https://www.snapchat.com/@brentrivera).
usernames.title: Usernames or Profile URLs
